name: Reachout
tagline: A lead list into personalized outreach, drafted on your Claude — never auto-sent.
author: Switchboard
inside: A personalized N-touch sequence per lead, grounded in your ICP + a real hook
Staged as Gmail drafts — every send stays a human click (draft-not-send)

tools.name: reachout_draft
tools.description: Draft/stage the next due outreach touches for a campaign, grounded in the ICP + each lead's hook. Renders the campaign board live and returns what was drafted. Stages Gmail DRAFTS only — it never sends.
